baseline_diagnostics.classification: revision 8 baseline, includes selector and extra-contract assertion defects
one global-list snapshot contaminated by concurrent workbook creation; superseded by serial 196/196

implementation_findings.observation: Induced failure persisting teams.json during member deletion returns 500 after organization membership was deleted; team membership and direct repository grant remain. Cross-store removal is not atomic.

PR detail excludes only the base commit itself, rather than subtracting the entire base reachable history from compare reachable history. UI includes the base ancestor; a direct probe also includes an unrelated sibling branch commit.

All Owner rows hide Member menu; not limited to preventing the last Owner removal. Browser refusal witness cannot reach the mandated menu. Backend last-Owner rejection is correct (400 and relationships preserved); backend removal of another Owner in a two-Owner organization succeeds (200). Do not interpret the UI failure as a broken backend last-Owner guard.

response.error: Cannot remove the last owner of the organization

implementation_findings.observation: Invalid and overlong team names show Team name format is invalid; the source requires the exact message Team name is invalid. Keep the source-prescribed assertion.

fixture_compatibility.classification: Stale/incomplete project seeds. The diagnostic variant changes only the disposable copy seed JSON; its score is not the score of the original project.
fixture_compatibility.improvement: Perform a fixture-manifest preflight and report setup failures distinctly while retaining all enabled acceptance assertions.

specification_changes.change: Scope reviewSummary to textbox Summary or the review form Comment textbox; exclude optional Comment radio and mounted inline comment editors.
Remove the unsupported assumption that pending checks cannot already have a setter. Retain the independent visitor check of persisted status and setter.
Allow comparison commit information as the seeded message or exact compare-only commit count, without forcing one presentation format.
Use a rendered message witness that permits an adjacent inline SHA, while preserving strict identity token matching. Assert PR history excludes base and base ancestors.
Document one worker per server/data instance; parallel execution needs isolated server/storage per worker. Preserve full-list absence-of-partial-record assertions.
Record cross-store organization member removal in the remaining implementation-harness coverage gaps; retain reproducible target-specific fault probes separately from portable gates.

validation.frozen_source_audit: Both source suites audited after revision 9 freeze; case counts remain GitHub 172 and Sheet 196.
setup_incidents: Initial unconfigured browser calibration lacked NODE_PATH; rerun with local-grader/node_modules succeeded.
Initial whole-repository unittest discovery lacked PYTHONPATH for two imported modules; configured discovery completed successfully.

limits: A passing portable browser suite does not certify all authorization, storage-failure, real restart, concurrent commit graph, or locale/date grammar clauses.
Sheet showed no product defect in the 196 browser cases and 39 existing backend tests; previously recorded coverage gaps still apply.
Implementation findings were reproduced and documented; application implementation fixes are outside this execution/audit request.
